title: Parsley Health carousel arrows
description: Round arrow buttons for the site's card carousels (outlined clover ring with a sage arrow, a solid forest disc, or a small sage dot), plus a hook that scrolls a scroll-snap track by one card and reports whether it is at either end and which card is current.
notes: the hook needs JavaScript: blocks that use it set hydrate
scrolls smoothly, or instantly under reduced motion
name: parsleyhealth-carousel

props.name: variant
props.description: ring: 48px clover outline, sage arrow · solid: 48px forest disc · dot: 30px sage disc

props.name: disabled
props.description: greyed out (at the end of the track)
